import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_totient_sum (n : ℕ) : (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, Nat.totient d) = n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_d_totient_sum (n : ℕ) : (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, Nat.totient d) = n
:= by
  induction' n with a ha
  · simp [Nat.divisors_zero, Nat.totient_zero]
  · have : (∑ d ∈ a.divisors, Nat.totient d) = a := study_d_totient_sum ha
    rw [this]
    simp [Nat.divisors_pos, Nat.divisors_eq_divisors_of_pos ha, Nat.totient_add]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.study_d_totient_sum = Nl2LeanCandidate.study_d_totient_sum := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.study_d_totient_sum
